subject: general
question: Ustad Allah Rakha was famous for playing the ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tabla.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Alla Rakha Qureshi **popularly known as Alla Rakha, was an Indian tabla player who specialized in **Hindustani classical music****.**
 
• He was a **frequent accompanist of sitar player Pandit Ravi Shankar **and was largely responsible for **introducing Tabla to the western audience**.
 
• Alla Rakha **left home at age 12 **to learn tabla under the great master (ustad)** Mian Qadir Baksh.**
 
• He also trained under Ashik Ali Khan, a vocalist admired especially for his mastery of the **khayal Hindustani** song repertoire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ravi Shankar**, the renowned master of the **Indian sitar.****​ **
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan **(born 9 October 1945) is an **Indian classical sarod player**, best known for his clear and **fast ekhara taans.**
 
• **Hariprasad Chaurasia** (born 1 July 1938) is an Indian music director and** classical flautist, **who plays the flute, in the Hindustani classical tradition.
